name: Breaker position-discrepancy alarm
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
summary: Reports an auxiliary-contact combination that persists beyond the allowed transition interval.
description: Reports an auxiliary-contact combination that persists beyond the allowed transition interval. Breaker status indications describe the operating mechanism, the removable truck or the health of a supporting system. These signals are related but are not interchangeable: an open breaker can still have its truck connected to live bus contacts.

In a switchgear control schematic, the bay controller compares independent status contacts before displaying a position or allowing another operation. The signal labels explain which physical state each contact represents. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Auxiliary-contact disagreement” at the input and “Position-discrepancy alarm” at the output. The transition allowance is project-specific.
